applicationSettings.description: Canonical UTF-8 settings must additionally fit 64 KiB; semantic validation is authoritative.

applicationLaunch.description: Canonical UTF-8 metadata must additionally fit 256 KiB; paths must bind to the declared input tree.

scriptDependencyProfile.description: Canonical UTF-8 declaration must fit 256 KiB. Native semantics additionally validate expansion, reference conflicts, path overlaps, prerequisite targets and total expanded bounds.

script.description: Canonical UTF-8 declaration must fit 256 KiB. Native semantics additionally validate expansion, reference conflicts, path overlaps, prerequisite targets and total expanded bounds.

standaloneScript.description: The companion for <stem>.kt is <stem>.kvik.json; durable lock is <stem>.kvik.lock.json. Native validation rejects workspace dependencies/plugins, and the CLI must bind the selected .kt to an explicit source file.

sourceGraphInput.description: Structural source graph contract. Semantic validation must additionally check sorted unique IDs/lists, acyclic reachable dependency closures, exact library order, directory coverage, normalized nonoverlapping paths, UTF-8 byte and aggregate limits, compiler option pairs, and immutable URL consistency. The input parser also rejects duplicate JSON keys and noninteger numeric tokens. A valid document is not evidence that source/artifact bytes have been acquired or verified.

sourceGraphObserved.description: Structural source graph contract. Semantic validation must additionally check sorted unique IDs/lists, acyclic reachable dependency closures, exact library order, directory coverage, normalized nonoverlapping paths, UTF-8 byte and aggregate limits, compiler option pairs, and immutable URL consistency. The input parser also rejects duplicate JSON keys and noninteger numeric tokens. A valid document is not evidence that source/artifact bytes have been acquired or verified.

preparedApplication.description: Canonical UTF-8 descriptor must additionally fit 8 KiB and bind a completed application preparation record.

applicationReady.description: Invocation-local strict canonical JSON, at most 8 KiB UTF-8; Native parsing additionally enforces valid Unicode, UTF-16 path lengths and digest bindings. Started means process-host acceptance, not health or successful exit.

applicationActivation.description: Invocation-local strict canonical JSON, at most 8 KiB UTF-8; Native parsing additionally enforces valid Unicode, UTF-16 path lengths and digest bindings. Started means process-host acceptance, not health or successful exit.
